eligibility: Dates must remain in the original CVE role, every history must contain an observed score, and the endpoint must be observed. Never select by change magnitude.
weighting: Equal total weight per CVE: 1 / eligible windows per CVE if pooling all leads, or 1 / eligible anchors per CVE within a separately trained lead.
limitations: Descriptive feasibility only; no model, forecasts, graph construction or automatic decision to train.
The retained cohort was selected for the earlier Day-60 task, not every possible rolling-origin CVE.
Later anchors are later decisions, not improved early warning from Day 30.
Multiple windows from one CVE are dependent; preserve CVE roles and equal total CVE weight.
Date eligibility is checked before inspecting window scores; blocked windows have no numeric target or change exported.
Daily score dates do not verify exact release times. Input values on an anchor date require a consistent end-of-day convention later.
Validation has informed prior development. No final test CVE scores or text are inspected or exported.
Changed-score counts are descriptive outcomes, never criteria for selecting windows or assigning weights.
